title: Clicking a node opens a panel that changes its colours and strokes
body:
Changing a fill or stroke means editing the source by hand.

## Proposal

- With one node selected, a right-hand panel lists the properties the kind takes that a person changes by eye: `fill`, `stroke`, `stroke-width`, `dash`, `text-color`, `text-size`, `font`, with the current value of each (the node's own, a style's, or the default).
- A colour picker or field per colour, a number field per size; a change writes the property on the node through a new `property_edits(source, node, key, value)`, replacing the node's own value or inserting one, which then overrides a style. A value from a `let` is refused with the reason.
- `none` is a choice where the property takes it.
close_reason: Landed in 68b4632. `scene::edit::property_edits` sets a key on one or more nodes and `scene::edit::property_values` reads each value with whether the node, a style or the default sets it; acre-gui's right-hand panel is `crates/acre-gui/src/properties.rs`. The panel also lists `color`, which text, math, caption and table nodes take for their text. It shows "default" without a value, because the defaults differ by kind inside `build.rs`.
